Instead of filling out a checklist of "Stuff a kit needs" just think of the situations you want to be prepared for. Someone who's expecting the SHTF scenario and wants to hike back to a safe point is going to have a very different kit than someone who just wants to get out of the ditch in the winter.

  • TIRE BLOWOUT

A jack, tire iron, and check your donut tire regularly for pressure. Fix-a-Flat.

  • DEAD BATTERY

Jumper cables or a jumpstart device.

  • CAR CRASH

First aid kit, emergency cell phone.

  • STRANDED OVERNIGHT

Blanket or sleeping bag, an MRE or two.
